story: Old Kona Airport State Recreation Area is a park built on the site of an old landing strip just north of Kailua in Hawaii, USA. The facilities span 103.7 acres of the old airport. A marine preserve was created off shore in 1992.
matters: A marine preserve was created off shore in 1992, featuring a day use boat mooring near Shark Rock.
name: Old Kona Airport State Recreation Area
